== Biography ==
Robert Glasgow was born 6 Jun 1670. He was the son of [[Glasgow-1512|Robert Glasgow]] and [[Donald-1722|Margaret Donald]].  He was baptized on 9 June 1670 in Ayr, Ayrshire, Scotland.<ref>"Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950," database, FamilySearch, https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XY8Z-L2Z (accessed 2025), Robert Glasgow, 1670.</ref>
